key: "Lapis Bicycle Luxury-- Ride right!"
en: "Lapis Bicycle Luxury-- Ride right!"
ja: 「ラピス高級自転車店――正しく乗ろう!」

key: "Peony Station"
en: "Peony Station"
ja: 「ピオニー駅」

key: Locked.
en: Locked.
ja: 鍵がかかっている。

key: A world like this is proof that prayers can be answered.
en: A world like this is proof that prayers can be answered.
ja: こんな世界があるってことは、祈りが届く証拠だ。

key: Stay true, child, to whatever spirit guides you, even if it is your own.
en: Stay true, child, to whatever spirit guides you, even if it is your own.
ja: 己を導く魂に誠実であれ、子よ、たとえそれが自分自身の魂であっても。

key: "Dr. Connal's Orphanage and Psychiatric Treatment Center"
en: "Dr. Connal's Orphanage and Psychiatric Treatment Center"
ja: 「コナル博士の孤児院兼精神科治療センター」

key: \PN used the Orphanage Key!
en: \PN used the Orphanage Key!
ja: \PNは孤児院のカギを使った!

key: The door unlocked!
en: The door unlocked!
ja: ドアの鍵が開いた!

key: Tch, where did that Gym Leader even go?!
en: Tch, where did that Gym Leader even go?!
ja: チッ、あのジムリーダー、いったいどこに行ったんだよ?!

key: I've been waiting around forever to challenge her, but no one seems to know where she disappeared to.
en: I've been waiting around forever to challenge her, but no one seems to know where she disappeared to.
ja: ずっと挑戦しようと待ってるのに、彼女がどこに消えたのか誰も知らないみたいだ。

key: I can see the whole Azurine Region from here! There's Pyrous Mountain, with the smoke rising up, and there's the ashen beach... How pretty!
en: I can see the whole Azurine Region from here!  There's Pyrous Mountain, with the smoke rising up, and there's the ashen beach... How pretty!
ja: ここからアズリン地方が全部見えるぞ!煙が立ち上るパイロス山があって、灰色の浜辺もある……なんてきれいなんだ!

key: This big building has really quieted down lately!
en: This big building has really quieted down lately!
ja: この大きな建物、最近ずいぶん静かになったな!

key: There's no more people going in and out of it or anything! Did something happen?
en: There's no more people going in and out of it or anything! Did something happen?
ja: もう出入りする人もいないみたいだし!何かあったのか?

key: You look like you've seen a few battles in your day.
en: You look like you've seen a few battles in your day.
ja: あんたは今まで何度もバトルを経験してきたみたいだな。

key: Lots of people in the city used to battle each other over resources or just to prove themselves,
en: Lots of people in the city used to battle each other over resources or just to prove themselves,
ja: 昔はこの街の多くの人が、資源をめぐって、あるいはただ自分を証明するためだけに、互いに戦ってたもんだ。

key: But lately all of that has quieted down.
en: But lately all of that has quieted down.
ja: でも最近は、そういうのもすっかり落ち着いた。

key: People can really come together when it counts, huh?
en: People can really come together when it counts, huh?
ja: いざとなれば、人って本当に力を合わせられるもんなんだな。

key: "Lapis Library Gym"
en: "Lapis Library Gym"
ja: 「ラピス図書館ジム」

key: Run away with me.
en: Run away with me.
ja: 私と逃げよう。

key: We can go anywhere in the world.
en: We can go anywhere in the world.
ja: 世界中どこへでも行けるよ。

key: With me at your side, you can have anything you want.
en: With me at your side, you can have anything you want.
ja: 私がそばにいれば、何だって手に入る。

key: Uh, could you like, not?
en: Uh, could you like, not?
ja: あの、それやめてもらえます?

key: Right now I mostly just want you to not be at my side, but thanks.
en: Right now I mostly just want you to not be at my side, but thanks.
ja: 今のところ、あなたにはそばにいてほしくないんですけど、どうも。

key: <>- Dahlia Street\nv -3rd Street
en: <>- Dahlia Street\nv -3rd Street
ja: <>- ダリア通り\nv -3番街

key: Say, if the elderly hoards all the wealth in the city, wouldn't that mean they would just have to die before that saved money trickles down?
en: Say, if the elderly hoards all the wealth in the city, wouldn't that mean they would just have to die before that saved money trickles down?
ja: なあ、街の富を年寄りが独り占めしてるなら、そいつらが死なない限り、その貯め込んだ金が下に回ってこないってことにならないか?

key: Uh, not that I'm planning on doing anything, of course!
en: Uh, not that I'm planning on doing anything, of course!
ja: あ、もちろん何かするつもりってわけじゃないぞ!

key: But just hypothetically speaking, if most of the population was really so impoverished, maybe it would have been for the best.
en: But just hypothetically speaking, if most of the population was really so impoverished, maybe it would have been for the best.
ja: でもあくまで仮の話として、住民のほとんどが本当にそこまで貧しいなら、そうなった方がよかったのかもな。

key: Hey, have you heard about the Gym Leader here?
en: Hey, have you heard about the Gym Leader here?
ja: なあ、ここのジムリーダーの話、聞いたか?

key: She's just a young girl, but I hear she's been traveling around fighting Team Meteor!
en: She's just a young girl, but I hear she's been traveling around fighting Team Meteor!
ja: まだ若い女の子なのに、チームメテオと戦って各地を回ってるらしいぞ!

key: Give 'em one from the Lapis Ward, Shelly!
en: Give 'em one from the Lapis Ward, Shelly!
ja: ラピスワードから一発かましてやれ、シェリー!

key: Hey you.
en: Hey you.
ja: よう、あんた。

key: This here is OUR park.
en: This here is OUR park.
ja: ここは俺たちの公園だ。

key: That means you gotta respect.
en: That means you gotta respect.
ja: つまり、敬意を払えってことだ。

key: No littering. No loitering. No picking on the Pokémon. Ya dig?
en: No littering. No loitering. No picking on the Pokémon.  Ya dig?
ja: ゴミ捨て禁止。たむろ禁止。ポケモンいじめ禁止。わかるか?

key: These men are working hard, but there's much to do before we can officially open access to the north.
en: These men are working hard, but there's much to do before we can officially open access to the north.
ja: こいつらは頑張って働いてるが、北への正式な立ち入りを許可するにはまだやることが多いんだ。

key: Besides, there have been some delays with this part of the project.
en: Besides, there have been some delays with this part of the project.
ja: それに、このあたりの計画には遅れも出ててな。

key: Seems shady figures have been sticking their hands into places they aren't supposed to, hm?
en: Seems shady figures have been sticking their hands into places they aren't supposed to, hm?
ja: 怪しい連中が、手を出しちゃいけない場所に手を伸ばしてるみたいだな、うん?

key: OFFICER: Really sorry about that. That woman is nuts.
en: OFFICER: Really sorry about that. That woman is nuts.
ja: 警察官:本当に申し訳ない。あの女はイカれてるんだ。

key: Don't worry, you're not really a suspect.
en: Don't worry, you're not really a suspect.
ja: 心配しないでくれ、あんたが本当に容疑者ってわけじゃない。

key: But you know what, \PN, I never did properly thank you for saving me before. So I want you to have this.
en: But you know what, \PN, I never did properly thank you for saving me before. So I want you to have this.
ja: でもなあ\PN、前に助けてもらった時、ちゃんとお礼を言ってなかったな。だからこれを受け取ってくれ。

key: Look, that was kind of a stressful thing for both of us. I'm really not a fan of blaming innocents.
en: Look, that was kind of a stressful thing for both of us. I'm really not a fan of blaming innocents.
ja: あれはお互いにとって、なかなかストレスのかかることだったろ。俺は無実の人間を責めるのは本当に好きじゃないんだ。

key: Do you wanna take this as an apology?
en: Do you wanna take this as an apology?
ja: これを謝罪の印として受け取ってくれるか?

key: My brother works at the cycle shop up here. He gave us that for a present for my little girl.
en: My brother works at the cycle shop up here. He gave us that for a present for my little girl.
ja: 俺の兄弟がここの自転車屋で働いててな。それを俺の娘へのプレゼントにってくれたんだ。

key: Unfortunately, she... didn't survive that whole mess in Beryl.
en: Unfortunately, she... didn't survive that whole mess in Beryl.
ja: でも残念ながら、あの子は……ベリルであった一連の騒動を生き延びられなかった。

key: She was reading in her room, and then the plants broke through the wall. She was...
en: She was reading in her room, and then the plants broke through the wall. She was...
ja: 部屋で本を読んでたんだが、そこに植物が壁を突き破ってきて。あの子は……

key: ...Nevermind.
en: ...Nevermind.
ja: ……もういい。

key: I don't want to think about it. Please, just take this off of me.
en: I don't want to think about it. Please, just take this off of me.
ja: 考えたくないんだ。頼むから、これを俺から受け取ってくれ。

key: Sorry.
en: Sorry.
ja: すまない。

key: Growlithe is dutifully waiting outside.
en: Growlithe is dutifully waiting outside.
ja: ガーディはお利口に外で待っている。

key: Well, this city's really come together.
en: Well, this city's really come together.
ja: まあ、この街も本当にまとまったもんだな。

key: Not that I can claim any part in it.
en: Not that I can claim any part in it.
ja: 俺が何か関わったってわけじゃないけどな。

key: Perhaps it's too late though.
en: Perhaps it's too late though.
ja: もう遅すぎるかもしれないが。

key: Ehh? They're still looking for help at the Coral Gym?
en: Ehh? They're still looking for help at the Coral Gym?
ja: えっ?コーラルジムはまだ人手を探してるのか?

key: Hrmm! All right!
en: Hrmm! All right!
ja: うーむ!よし!

key: Looks like it's time for this old bird to fly into action after all!
en: Looks like it's time for this old bird to fly into action after all!
ja: どうやら、この年寄りも一肌脱ぐ時が来たみたいだな!

key: Watch out, Reborn! I'm comin' for you!
en: Watch out, Reborn! I'm comin' for you!
ja: リボーン、待ってろ!今から行くぜ!

key: The Lapis Ward is the most affluent ward in the city.
en: The Lapis Ward is the most affluent ward in the city.
ja: ラピスワードはこの街で一番の高級ワードだ。

key: Needless to say, we have high standards when it comes to our Pokémon.
en: Needless to say, we have high standards when it comes to our Pokémon.
ja: 言うまでもなく、うちのポケモンには高い基準を求めているんだよ。

key: Our Pokémon's individual strengths are so high compared to trainers in other wards--
en: Our Pokémon's individual strengths are so high compared to trainers in other wards--
ja: 他のワードのトレーナーに比べて、うちのポケモンの個々の強さは段違いでね――

key: it's not even a competition!
en: it's not even a competition!
ja: もう勝負にすらならないよ!

key: If only I could tell someone "highstandard".
en: If only I could tell someone "highstandard".
ja: 誰かに「highstandard」って言えたらよかったのになあ。

key: Then my opponents would all have the same standards as me-- perfectly bred Pokémon!
en: Then my opponents would all have the same standards as me-- perfectly bred Pokémon!
ja: そうすれば相手もみんな同じ基準になるのに――完璧に厳選されたポケモンってね!

key: <- Peony Circle\n^v -4th Street
en: <- Peony Circle\n^v -4th Street
ja: <- ピオニーサークル\n^v -4番街

key: >- Crocus Road\n^v -4th Street
en: >- Crocus Road\n^v -4th Street
ja: >- クロッカス通り\n^v -4番街

key: <- Hydrangea Street\n^v -5th Street
en: <- Hydrangea Street\n^v -5th Street
ja: <- ハイドランジア通り\n^v -5番街

key: <- Dahlia Street\nv -5th Street
en: <- Dahlia Street\nv -5th Street
ja: <- ダリア通り\nv -5番街

key: <>- Dahlia Street\nv -4th Street
en: <>- Dahlia Street\nv -4th Street
ja: <>- ダリア通り\nv -4番街

key: <>- Hydrangea Street\n^v -4th Street
en: <>- Hydrangea Street\n^v -4th Street
ja: <>- ハイドランジア通り\n^v -4番街

key: ARCHER: I'm gonna leave dealing with her to you, \PN. I'll stand guard and make sure no one interferes.
en: ARCHER: I'm gonna leave dealing with her to you, \PN. I'll stand guard and make sure no one interferes.
ja: アーチャー: 彼女の相手は君に任せる、\PN。私は見張りをして、誰にも邪魔をさせない。

key: MAXWELL: The floor is yours, \PN. Go show her what 'glory' means. I'll make sure no one gets in your way.
en: MAXWELL: The floor is yours, \PN. Go show her what 'glory' means. I'll make sure no one gets in your way.
ja: マクスウェル: 舞台は譲るぜ、\PN。「栄光」ってやつを彼女に見せつけてやれ。オレが邪魔者は片づけとく。

key: ARCHER: Well done. I do believe that will be sufficient to see her excised from 7th Street.
en: ARCHER: Well done. I do believe that will be sufficient to see her excised from 7th Street.
ja: アーチャー: よくやった。これで彼女を7番街から締め出すには十分だろう。

key: I won't keep you any longer, but one gift, from me to you. A member of the Aqua Gang should naturally find this useful.
en: I won't keep you any longer, but one gift, from me to you. A member of the Aqua Gang should naturally find this useful.
ja: 長くは引き止めない。だが一つ、私から君への贈り物だ。アクア団の一員なら当然役に立つはずだ。

key: ARCHER: I'll see you around.
en: ARCHER: I'll see you around.
ja: アーチャー: また会おう。

key: MAXWELL: That? Was hilarious. Good show! I bet she won't be showing her tail around down there for quite some time.
en: MAXWELL: That? Was hilarious. Good show! I bet she won't be showing her tail around down there for quite some time.
ja: マクスウェル: いやあ、傑作だったな。いい見世物だったぜ!しばらくはあいつもあの辺りに顔を出せないだろうよ。

key: Hey, thanks for your help. I have one more gift for you.
en: Hey, thanks for your help. I have one more gift for you.
ja: おい、手伝ってくれて助かったぜ。もう一つ贈り物があるんだ。

key: MAXWELL: Not bad for a group like ours, yeah? I'll see you on the flip-side. For glory, baby!
en: MAXWELL: Not bad for a group like ours, yeah? I'll see you on the flip-side. For glory, baby!
ja: マクスウェル: オレたちにしちゃ上出来だろ?じゃあまたな。栄光のために、ベイビー!

key: Oh, if I only have a few more years left to live, I'm glad I could spend them here, seeing what this place has become.
en: Oh, if I only have a few more years left to live, I'm glad I could spend them here, seeing what this place has become.
ja: ああ、残された時間があとわずかだとしても、この場所がどうなったか見届けながら過ごせてうれしいよ。

key: Hey, did you know?
en: Hey, did you know?
ja: ねえ、知ってた?

key: The winds in Reborn are sometimes so strong that they allow Flying-type Pokémon to ignore their weaknesses!
en: The winds in Reborn are sometimes so strong that they allow Flying-type Pokémon to ignore their weaknesses!
ja: リボーンの風は時々とても強くて、ひこうタイプのポケモンが弱点を無視できるくらいなんだよ!

key: And now with all these flowers around the city, don't they smell lovely?
en: And now with all these flowers around the city, don't they smell lovely?
ja: それに今じゃ街中に花があふれてて、いい香りがするでしょ?

key: It's been a long time since I was a little girl.
en: It's been a long time since I was a little girl.
ja: あたしが小さな女の子だった頃から、もう長い時間がたったわ。

key: Back then I would sit up here and watch the trains roll by.
en: Back then I would sit up here and watch the trains roll by.
ja: あの頃はここに座って、電車が通り過ぎるのを眺めてたの。

key: Everything is different now--
en: Everything is different now--
ja: 今は何もかもが違う――

key: But maybe there's another train coming in soon.
en: But maybe there's another train coming in soon.
ja: でも、もうすぐまた次の電車が来るのかもしれない。

key: "Sweet Scent" Flower Shop
en: "Sweet Scent" Flower Shop
ja: 「あまいかおり」花屋

key: For all your floral needs~
en: For all your floral needs~
ja: お花のことなら何でもおまかせ～

key: I'm gonna work super hard to make the Lapis Ward rad!
en: I'm gonna work super hard to make the Lapis Ward rad!
ja: あたし、ラピスワードを最高の場所にするためにめちゃくちゃ頑張るんだ!

key: Or at least, I'll work hard enough to earn the elders' trust so I can make off with some of their cash money, heh heh...
en: Or at least, I'll work hard enough to earn the elders' trust so I can make off with some of their cash money, heh heh...
ja: まあ少なくとも、年寄り連中の信用を得てその金をちょろまかせるくらいには頑張るけどね、ふふ……

key: AQUA: Heyy bro, how's it hangin'?
en: AQUA: Heyy bro, how's it hangin'?
ja: アクア: よお兄弟、調子はどうだ?

key: Huh. You're trying to get back a rare Pokémon that I had?
en: Huh. You're trying to get back a rare Pokémon that I had?
ja: ん?オレが持ってたレアポケモンを取り返しに来たのか?

key: Shit, I had no idea it was one of our own.
en: Shit, I had no idea it was one of our own.
ja: くそ、仲間のポケモンだったなんて知らなかったぜ。

key: Sorry mate, I sold it down on 7th Street. There's a vendor down there so maybe you could go get it from him.
en: Sorry mate, I sold it down on 7th Street. There's a vendor down there so maybe you could go get it from him.
ja: 悪いな、それなら7番街で売っちまった。あそこに業者がいるから、そいつから買い戻せるかもな。

key: AQUA: Sorry mate, I sold that Pokémon down on 7th Street. There's a vendor down there so maybe you could go get it from him.
en: AQUA: Sorry mate, I sold that Pokémon down on 7th Street. There's a vendor down there so maybe you could go get it from him.
ja: アクア: 悪いな、そのポケモンなら7番街で売っちまった。あそこに業者がいるから、そいつから買い戻せるかもな。

key: AQUA: Huh. Looks like another butthurt Magma moron. I'll put you down just like I stomped out the one I stole that Pokémon from!
en: AQUA: Huh. Looks like another butthurt Magma moron. I'll put you down just like I stomped out the one I stole that Pokémon from!
ja: アクア: ふん。また泣き言を言うマグマの馬鹿かよ。あのポケモンを奪った時と同じように、お前もぶちのめしてやる!

key: Grr! I should've kept that Pokemon myself to beat you!
en: Grr! I should've kept that Pokemon myself to beat you!
ja: ぐぬぬ!あのポケモンを手元に置いといて、お前を倒すべきだった!

key: AQUA: Hmph! You're out of luck. I already sold that Pokémon on 7th Street. Good luck getting it back, unless you buy it from the vendor!
en: AQUA: Hmph! You're out of luck. I already sold that Pokémon on 7th Street. Good luck getting it back, unless you buy it from the vendor!
ja: アクア: ふん!運が悪かったな。あのポケモンはもう7番街で売っちまった。業者から買い戻さない限り、取り返すのは無理だぜ!

key: <- Crocus Road\n^ -5th Street
en: <- Crocus Road\n^ -5th Street
ja: <- クロッカス通り\n^ -5番街
